title: Midnight at the Crossroads
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: Two strangers keep meeting at the same all-night bus station — always at midnight, always missing each other — until one night the timetable changes.
style: Witty, warm first-person alternating viewpoints. Banter-heavy, hopeful, cinematic.
characters: Jo — night-shift nurse, sarcastic, soft; Bayo — musician, late for everything, honest.
setting: A 24-hour bus station in a restless city, present day.
notes: Open at 00:00 with Jo missing the bus and meeting Bayo for the first time (again). Spark, misunderstanding, promise of return.
